media_firmware_contract.scope: Fresh read-only matching MU1367 firmware extraction; receiver execution and lifetimes tested separately.

main_findings: Media reaches the receiver but does not reach the existing HMI text/picture adapters.

Receiver scheduling includes unnamed threads at priority 10 and native screen threads at 60; the fix selects only the alternate sender and dedicated 9997 adapter and preserves existing higher priorities.
Reverse-load freeze timing is vehicle feedback; reduction has not been verified in the vehicle.

host.scope: Actual release/base/legacy/AA/OEM shell controllers; host SHA verifier; config-patch replays exact outputs captured and hash-verified from the pinned native QNX helper; mounts/sync mocked; reboot RAM markers cleared by fixture.

flow.scope: Factory-ksh orchestration, reboot boundary, old OEM snapshot retention and real combined collector; child base/wireless transactions are stand-ins here, separately tested as actual controllers on host.

media_host.parser: WIRELESS_MEDIA_NATIVE_PASS fuzz=50000 delta_merge=1 malformed_atomic=1 utf8=1 bounds=1

transaction.baseline_seed: Published v1.5.4 final payload files; old installer not rerun in this fixture.

host_installer_hash_only_update.explanation: Same 41 targets and exact release/child shell logic. Only payload hash pins/build ID differ from the complete host migration/OEM matrix. Final QNX transaction test executes the final controller/payload pins.

limits: Vehicle reverse-load timing and actual MU/AID rendering remain to be tested.
Final QNX rollback and interrupted-recovery checks target both added media files; full install/removal checks all 41 targets. This is not a claim of 41 new failure-injection cases.
Factory-flow child transactions are explicit stand-ins; real migration/OEM controllers run in the host matrix.
Native receiver tests exercise actual parser/copy/completion code before hardware main. They do not emulate Bluetooth, MFi, MOST or a phone.
